import seaborn as sns

# Create a boxplot to visualize the relationship between gender and degree completion rates
sns.boxplot(x=gender_column, y=degree_completion_column, data=df)
plt.title('Relationship between Gender and Degree Completion Rates')
plt.xlabel('Gender')
plt.ylabel('Highest Grade Completed')
plt.show()

from scipy.stats import ttest_ind

# Convert gender to numerical values (1: Male, 2: Female)
df[gender_column] = df[gender_column].astype(int)

# Separate the data by gender
male_degrees = df[df[gender_column] == 1][degree_completion_column]
female_degrees = df[df[gender_column] == 2][degree_completion_column]

# Perform an independent samples t-test
t_statistic, p_value = ttest_ind(male_degrees, female_degrees)
t_statistic, p_value

# Check for missing values in the degree completion column
missing_values = df[degree_completion_column].isnull().sum()
print("Missing values in degree completion column:", missing_values)

# Check if the degree completion column is numeric
is_numeric = pd.api.types.is_numeric_dtype(df[degree_completion_column])
print("Is degree completion column numeric?", is_numeric)
